title: Order Total Reconciliation Agent
description: Reconciles order line extensions, discount, tax, and payable total using integer minor currency units.
decision: An order reconciles when line extensions and the declared discount and tax produce the stated total exactly.
inputs: The caller supplies a currency code, unique line identifiers, unit prices and quantities in minor units, discount, tax, and total in the same currency.
limitations: This is arithmetic validation only. It does not determine tax law, refund eligibility, payment settlement, or whether a price is commercially correct.

input_schema.description: The caller supplies a currency code, unique line identifiers, unit prices and quantities in minor units, discount, tax, and total in the same currency.
